address: Nispetiye Caddesi No:74, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34340, Türkiye
bio: Located in the heart of Beşiktaş, Sirali makes quite an impression. With its high ceilings, large windows and spacious kitchen, this restaurant is lively but still feels elegant – ideal for an intimate dinner or for larger parties wanting to sample a range of traditional Turkish food. The menu includes lahmacun with beef and lamb, fresh from the wood-fired oven, as well as succulent kebabs accompanied by a subtly tangy salad of tomatoes and olives. Whatever you choose, the chefs add thoughtful finishing touches and handle the fire with real skill. With such a striking array of dishes, you may not know where to start!
